english.title: Passenger on PSV put at risk / impede / cause discomfort to another traveller
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a passenger on a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) used for the carriage of passengers at separate fares, at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), put at risk, unreasonably impeded or caused discomfort to **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..),

(A)_[travelling on the vehicle]_
(B)_[entering the vehicle]_
(C)_[leaving the vehicle]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 6(1)(b) of the Public Service Vehicles (Conduct of Drivers, Inspectors, Conductors and Passengers) Regulations 1990 and section 25(3) of the Public Passenger Vehicles Act 1981.
